description: On a pole in the WTD 61 area of Manching air base; moved to another location on the base after refurbishment in September 2022 (International F-104 Society). Airbus Defence and Space works airfield and WTD 61 at Manching; not publicly accessible.

Ground instructional airframe coded 10, used as a mobile display by MBB/Airbus at Manching (916-starfighter German fate list, 2025). Airbus Defence and Space works airfield and WTD 61 at Manching; not publicly accessible.

Bought by EADS in 2013 and restored in bare metal to the factory code KE+377 in 2014-2016; used as a mobile display for Airbus Manching (International F-104 Society, photo January 2016). Airbus Defence and Space works airfield and WTD 61 at Manching; not publicly accessible.

Preserved inside the Airbus factory at Manching (916-starfighter German fate list, 2025); the airframe was damaged beyond repair on 11 July 1966. Airbus Defence and Space works airfield and WTD 61 at Manching; not publicly accessible.

Ground instructional airframe coded 11 at Manching, ex-WTD 61 trials aircraft 98+04 (916-starfighter German fate list, 2025). Airbus Defence and Space works airfield and WTD 61 at Manching; not publicly accessible.
